Smoke test: XLSX with basic spreadsheet data including tables

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/xlsx/stanley_cups.xlsx\"}", "{}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].mimeType())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].content())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].tables())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].metadata().format()?.excel()?.sheetCount())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].metadata().format()?.excel()?.sheetNames())
```
